svg.title: dheeraj-aws-portfolio: a 3D interactive portfolio hosted on AWS Amplify

g.text: A 3D portfolio you break open: twelve interactive three.js scenes, a command
palette, a built-in terminal and 15 explorer badges. Plain static files, no
build step, deployed from GitHub to AWS Amplify Hosting on every push.
